chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou infiltrate a secret, man-made facility disguised as a cave system. Gu Suizhou, acting shamelessly, forces Shen Feizhi to carry him and later uses a ruse involving feigned heat and pheromones to bypass security guards. They successfully enter an internal office space, where Shen Feizhi struggles to maintain his composure against Gu Suizhou's provocative behavior, eventually threatening him when Gu Suizhou pushes his limits regarding Shen Feizhi's emotional reactions.

new_characters.name: Leapton
new_characters.description: An ally who provides remote surveillance support, hacking, and technical assistance to Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou. Referred to as 'Lai Gou' by Gu Suizhou.

new_locations.description: A highly secretive program/facility that uses high-tech surveillance and internal office spaces hidden within natural-looking environments.
